comments.author: Bloodsport
comments.body:
Step 1: Acquire Level 8 Alcohol Trading
Step 2: Go to Marseille Merchant guild, find Quest: The Depths of the Wines of the World
Step 3: Go to the Duke of Guise, speak with him once.
Step 4:
Go to Bordeaux, talk to Market Keeper 2 times.
Go to London, talk to Market Keeper 1 time.
Go to Bergen, talk to Market Keeper 1 time.
Go to Amsterdam, talk to Market Keeper 1 time.
Step 5: Return to Marseille & speak with the Duke of Guise
Step 6: Return to Merchant Guild and turn in quest.
Step 7: Speak to Merchant GM, acquire Sommelier job.
